trial_court: VI-Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bangalore - M.C.No.4084/2014
case_name: Smt Padmapriya @ Priya S vs Sri Vijayachandran D
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife and respondent-husband were parties to a Hindu marriage. The husband filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and desertion. The trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the other party has been guilty of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that in a petition for dissolution of marriage, the burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the respondent has been guilty of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking permanent alimony must comply with the terms of a settlement agreement.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, it is clear that the respondent has agreed to pay permanent alimony and maintenance as per the joint memo.

outcome.final_order: The parties arrived at an amicable settlement and the appeal was partly allowed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
preparing a response to a divorce petition
advising on maintenance and custody matters in a divorce case
